title: Doppel(Kammer)Konzert
identity: Costin Miereanu’s Doppel(Kammer)Konzert (1985) is a concertante work for a saxophone soloist, percussion soloist and chamber orchestra, published by Salabert as EAS 18334. IRCAM and Salabert both give 16:40 and identify original performers at the 1985 Metz Festival. The saxophonist may use instruments from the sopranino through bass saxophone family, according to IRCAM’s work record.

evidence.claim: IRCAM gives 1985 composition, 16:40 duration, Salabert EAS 18334, commissioning by C.E.R.M. Metz, saxophonist plus percussion soloist and chamber orchestra. Detailed saxophone choices include sopranino, soprano, alto, tenor and bass; premiere performers were Daniel Kientzy, Wim Koopman and Hilversum Chamber Orchestra conducted by David Porcelijn.
Salabert’s composer brochure gives the same 16:40, instrumentation and premiere details.
evidence.source_name: Éditions Durand Salabert Eschig composer brochure

collection_flag: Original concertante work; not a solo-with-piano transcription. The publisher description treats the saxophone soloist as a multi-instrument role spanning the saxophone family. No pedagogical audience claim found.
gaps: No readable score or saxophone-specific part mapping was inspected.
No verified recording was located in this pass; confirm which saxophone(s) are required in the performed version before collection planning.
